page.title: Reviews widget
page.description: Platform reviews on your website — a single script tag

info.title: About the widget
info.body: The widget shows published reviews of the selected platforms. The public key is bound to the listed domains; if it leaks, rotate it — the old snippet stops working.

configurator.emptyHint: Create a widget, configure it and paste the snippet on the site

configurator.domainsHint: The widget works only on these domains

configurator.snippetHint: Paste before the closing body tag
configurator.rotateConfirm: Rotate the public key? The old snippet stops working — update it on the site.
